title: Binakol
lead:
{{Short description|Filipino chicken soup}} {{Use Philippine English|date=February 2023}} {{Use mdy dates|date=February 2023}} {{Infobox food | name = Binakol | image = | image_size = | caption = | alternate_name = *''Binakol na manok''
*Chicken ''binakol'' *''Binakoe'' | country = [[Philippines]] | region = [[Iloilo]] and [[Aklan]], [[Western Visayas]] | creator = | course = Main course | served = Hot | main_ingredient = [[Chicken as food|chicken]], [[coconut water]] | variations = | calories = | other = }} '''''Binakol''''', also spelled '''''binakoe''''', is a [[Filipino cuisine|Filipino]] [[chicken soup]] made from chicken cooked in [[coconut water]], grated coconut, [[green papaya]] (or [[chayote]]), [[leafy vegetable]]s, garlic, onion, ginger, lemongrass, and ''[[patis (sauce)|patis]]'' (fish sauce). It can be spiced with chilis.{{cite web |title=Going local: 6 Aklanon food you should try |url=http://langyaw.com/2014/06/03/6-aklanon-food-try/ |website=Langyaw |date=June 3, 2014 |access-date=June 6, 2019}}{{cite web |title=Chicken Binakol (Chicken Cooked in Coconut Water) Recipe |url=https://www.yummy.ph/recipe/chicken-binakol-filipino-recipe |website=Yummy.ph |access-date=April 20, 2019}} Binakol can also be prepared with other types of meat or seafood. Traditionally, it was cooked inside bamboo tubes or directly in halved coconut shells. The dish originates from the [[Western Visayas]], particularly the provinces of [[Iloilo]] and [[Aklan]].{{cite web |last1=Veneracion |first1=Connie |title=Chicken Binakol: Subtly Sweet Tinola With Coconut |url=https://casaveneracion.com/chicken-binakol-tinola-coconut/ |website=Casa Veneracion |date=November 13, 2018 |access-date=April 20, 2019}}{{cite web |title=Chicken Binakol |url=http://www.panlasangpinoymeatrecipes.com/chicken-binakol.htm |website=Panlasang Pinoy Meaty Recipes |access-date=April 20, 2019}} The dish is similar to ''[[tinola]]'' and ''[[ginataang manok]]'', except that the latter two use water and [[coconut milk]], respectively, instead of coconut water.{{cite web |title=Ginataang Manok (Chicken Stewed in Coconut Milk) Filipino Recipe! |url=http://www.savvynana.com/recipe/ginataang-manok-chicken-stewed-coconut-milk-filipino-recipe/ |website=Savvy Nana's |access-date=April 20, 2019 |archive-date=December 16, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211216100142/http://www.savvynana.com/recipe/ginataang-manok-chicken-stewed-coconut-milk-filipino-recipe/ |url-status=usurped }}{{cite web |title=Chicken Binakol |url=https://www.mamasguiderecipes.com/2018/12/29/chicken-binakol/ |website=Mama's Guide Recipes |access-date=April 20, 2019}}
